classification.difficultyReason: Read whole shapes and shaded equal parts, write the mixed numeral, and count all parts for the improper fraction; the supplied partitions and answer frames guide both representations.

content.prompt: For each of these diagrams, write the mixed numeral and the improper fraction.

spec.description: Two squares divided vertically into halves; the first is fully shaded and the left half of the second is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Three shaded halves represent one whole and one half.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied fraction model is visible; response boxes are empty.

answer.worked:
There is 1 whole and 1 shaded half. Each whole contains 2 halves.
$$\begin{align*}1\frac{1}{2}&=\frac{2+1}{2}\\1\frac{1}{2}&=\frac{3}{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three squares divided by both diagonals; the first two are fully shaded and the left and right triangles of the third are shaded.
spec.mathematics: Ten shaded quarters represent two wholes and two quarters.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied fraction model is visible; response boxes are empty.

answer.worked:
There are 2 wholes and 2 shaded quarters. Each whole contains 4 quarters.
$$\begin{align*}2\frac{2}{4}&=\frac{4+4+2}{4}\\2\frac{2}{4}&=\frac{10}{4}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Three upright flat triangles partitioned into equal-area thirds through their centroids; the first two are fully shaded and the left region of the third is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Seven shaded thirds represent two wholes and one third. These are flat fraction models, not solids.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied fraction model is visible; response boxes are empty.

answer.worked:
There are 2 wholes and 1 shaded third. Each whole contains 3 thirds.
$$\begin{align*}2\frac{1}{3}&=\frac{3+3+1}{3}\\2\frac{1}{3}&=\frac{7}{3}\end{align*}$$
